title: Warm Workspace — Notion-Style Analytics Suite
description: A warm off-white analytics dashboard built for Notion-adjacent products — four rounded KPI cards, a soft-clay area chart, and a compact filterable table that reads like a living doc, not a war room.
philosophy: This template rejects the cold blue glow of traditional BI dashboards in favor of the approachable warmth that made Notion a cultural moment. It believes metrics don't have to intimidate: soft rounded panels, a single restrained clay accent, and generous cream breathing room let numbers speak without demanding theater. It is built for teams who review work weekly and present to themselves, not to boardrooms. It refuses palette overload and severity-color conventions, trusting one quiet hue to guide the eye across the entire layout.
goodFor: Weekly async workspace usage reviews shared with internal teams
SaaS product metric snapshots embedded in customer onboarding decks
3–4 KPI highlight moments during a live product demo
All-hands slides where usage data supports a narrative rather than dominates it
avoidFor: Executive boardroom quarterly reviews requiring dense multi-series charts
Financial reporting with strict color-coding and compliance display conventions
Dark-mode cyberpunk or high-contrast tech-forward presentation themes
Slides comparing six or more simultaneous data dimensions side by side
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The slide should feel like the cover page of a beautifully kept Notion workspace — calm, warm, and quietly confident rather than theatrical. Compositional rhythm is airy and asymmetric: a sparse typographic left block balances against a single soft rounded shape drifting right, as if a KPI card is just surfacing from the background. One muted clay accent carries all visual energy while the rest of the canvas breathes in cream warmth. Avoid sharp edges, saturated gradients, glowing halos, or any visual weight that signals urgency or boardroom severity.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid with a 10% outer margin on all sides; title sits left-aligned in cols 2–9, subtitle indented one column further right beneath it. A large ghost rounded-rectangle — evoking a KPI card surfacing from the background — anchors the lower-right quadrant as the sole structural visual element. A small deck-identifier tag occupies the bottom-left corner. No top header band; the full upper canvas is left as open breathing air.

examples.promptCore: The slide should feel like a well-crafted internal doc opened on a Monday morning — calm, purposeful, and confident without fanfare. Compositional rhythm is modular but airy: four peer KPI cards form a gentle horizontal drumbeat at the top, while the asymmetric chart-and-table split below introduces quiet tension without clutter or hierarchy aggression. A single muted clay accent threads through the chart area fill and one card's highlight value to guide the eye softly across the layout. Avoid clinical BI density, severity-color conventions, and any compositional drama that reads as a war-room briefing rather than a team check-in.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid with a generous 7% outer margin on all sides and a visible gutter between panels. The top row holds four equal-width rounded KPI cards spanning the full content area, each with comfortable inner padding and a faint shadow for lift — no dividing lines between them, just breathing space. Below, a soft area chart occupies roughly two-thirds of the horizontal content area, with a compact filterable table in the remaining third to its right, both panels vertically aligned to the same top edge. Slide number sits quietly in the bottom-right corner; no header band or top rule is used.
